findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name AnyIO unsafe deserialization
 * @description Detects uses of pickle and other unsafe deserialization APIs.
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/anyio-unsafe-deserialization
 * @tags security
 *       external/cwe/cwe-502
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall()
select call, "Use of pickle deserialization, which can be unsafe on untrusted data."
findings.hypothesis: AnyIO may use pickle for IPC or internal data passing, which is unsafe on untrusted input.
